notes.title: Lots of Balls keeps growing!
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/5qFQfUZggv7pSRcVzi/giphy.gif[/img]

                 [h1]Lots of Balls keeps growing with it's major updates![/h1]

[b]Since release we've added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Quick Play
[*] Mouse support for player movement
[*] New Extra: Pigs in Space
[*] New Extra: Space Clicker
[*] Several improvements and bug fixes!
[/list]

[b]Keep updated with Lots of Balls here:[/b]
